paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni in Pharisai vaihawmmi khat inn a an ne ding a ahoh in ana enkhia uhi.
heading: Sabbath Ni A Damlou Chibawk Hihdamna
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

paite: Huan ngai in ama ah damlou chibawk kuahiam a-om hi.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n dan thei mi leh Pharisaite ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihdam asiang hia, siang lou?" achi hi.
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

paite: Amau adai dide uhi. Ama'n damlou alawng a, hihdam in apaisakta hi.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Na lak uah kuahiam in sabiltung hiam bawngtal hiam nei unla, Sabbath ni in tuikul sung ah ke taleh kua ahia kaikhe pah lou ding?" achi hi.
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

paite: Huai thu adawng thei kei uhi.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

paite: Huan amichialte un tutna mun hoihpen atel zel uh amu a, akiang uah gentehna agen hi,
heading: Kingaihniamna Leh Siamna
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

paite: "Kitenna an ne ding a kuapeuh in ahon sap chiang in tutna mun hoihpen ah tu kei un; huchi lou in zaw noute sang a mizahtakhuai zaw ana sam kha dia, huchi in ahon sampa'n,
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

paite: 'Hiai mi tutna ding awn in,' ahon chi dia; huan nang zumpi in tutna mun niampen ah na tu nawn phing ding hi.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

paite: Ahon sap chiang in tutna mun niampen ah na va tu zaw ding a; huchi in ahon sampa ahong chiang in, na kiang ah, 'Lawm, tutna mun hoih deuh ah tu in, ahon chi thei ding hi.' Huchi in na an umpihte mitmuh in pahtawi in na om ding hi.
english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

paite: Kingaisang peuhmah aneu ding a; kingaineu pahtawi a om ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

paite: Huan asampa kiang ah leng, “Sun an hiam nitak an hiam a ankuang na lui chiang in, na lawmte, na unaute, na sanggamte, na inveng mihaute na sam kei ding hi; huchi lou in zaw ahon sam thuk ding ua, ahon thuk chitchiat kha ding uh.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

paite: Ankuang na lui chiang in, tagahte, piangsualte, khebaite, mittawte, na sam zaw ding hi.
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

paite: Huchi in huaite'n thukna ding aneih louh ziak un, na hampha ding; midikte thohnawn chiang a thukkik na hih ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

paite: Huan a-an umpih kuahiam in huai thu aza a, akiang ah, "Pathian lalgam a an ne ding mi ahampha," achi hi.
heading: Ankuangluina Gentehna / (Mat 22.1-10)
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, “Mi kuahiam in nitak in ankuang thupi alui a, mi tampi asam hi.
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

paite: An nek hun in, amisapte kiang ah, 'Hong paita un, bangkim amanta,' chi ding in asikha khat asawl hi.
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

paite: Huan avek un thukhat sat in paulam anei chiat uhi. Amasapen in akiang ah, 'Lou ka na lei a, a-en dia ka hoh kiphamoh ahi; hon hehpih inla, hon ngaisiam hen,' achi hi.
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

paite: Midang in 'Bawngtal tuak nga ka na lei a, asiat aphat chian ding in ka kuan ding a, hon hehpih inla, hon ngaisiam hen,' achi hi.
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

paite: Huan midang in, 'Zi ka na nei a, huaiziak in ka hoh thei kei,' achi hi.
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

paite: "Huan sikha in apu kiang ah, huai thute ava hilh hi. Huan inn neipa aheh a, asikha kiang ah, 'Kintak in pawt inla, kongzing leh kongkawm kal ah pai inla, mizawngte leh poihlongte leh mittawte leh khebaite hiai lai ah hon pilut in,' achi hi.
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

paite: Huan asikha in, 'Pu, na hon thupiak bang in ka hih khin a, himahleh mun awng lailai veh aw,' achi hi.
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

paite: Apu in, sikha kiang ah, 'Pawt inla, lamlian leh daikil kal ah pai inla, ka inn dimna ding in mi hon sawllut teitei in achi hi.'
english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, ka misapte khat in leng ka ankuang lui achiam kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

paite: Huan mipi tampitakte akiang ah ahoh ua; huchi in amah akihei a, akiang uah,
heading: Nungzuihna Man / (Mat 10.37-38)
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

paite: "Kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai in anu leh apa leh azi leh atate leh a-unaute leh asanggamnu leh ama hinna nangawn ahuat keileh ka nungzui ahi thei kei ding.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

paite: Kuapeuh ama kros pua a hon zui lou ka nungzui tak ahi thei kei ding.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

paite: "Nou lak a kuahiam in insang lam tum unla, kua ahia tu masa a, lam zohna khop sum na neih uleh neih louh thei ding a, abei ding zah sut masa lou ding?
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

paite: Huchi lou in zaw, suangphum khin phot a, alam zoh theih keileh a-en peuh in,
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

paite: 'Hiai mi'n gel napi in azou thei ngal kei chi in anuihsan ding uh.'
english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

paite: "Huan kumpipa kua'n ahia kumpipa dang dou ding a akuan ding in, tu masa a, mi singnih toh amah dou ding a hong, mi singkhat toh atuah ngam ding leh ding louh, mi dong lou ding?
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

paite: Huchi ahih kei vanglakleh kumpipa dang gamlapi a a-om lai in, kituahna lam thuchiam ngen ding in palai asawl ding hi.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

paite: Huchibang in, nou lak ah kuapeuh aneih tengteng paisan lou ka nungzui ahi thei kei ding hi.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

paite: "Chi ahoih a, himahleh chi apen khit in, bang in ahih al nawn dia?
heading: Chi Peng Zatna Bei / (Mat 5.13; Mar 9.50)
english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

paite: Lei a ding in ahoih kei; ekvum ding in leng ahoih sam kei; mi'n apaikhia uhi. Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei in za hen," achi hi.
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
